reconcile.note: JFB and Henry read Proverbs 1:28's non-finding as judgment on those who spurned Wisdom's earlier call, not a limit on Matthew 7:8's promise to sincere seekers.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible juxtaposes Matthew 7:8 and Proverbs 8:17's finding-promise against Proverbs 1:28's flat denial as an unresolved pairing.

sides.snippet: They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me
sides.verseText: Then will they call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
